[LTIM.6.3] Component ranges:

| Slot | Range | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `.hour` | `0..23` | |
| `.minute` | `0..59` | |
| `.second` | `0..59` | No leap-second representation in v1 |
| `.day` | `1..31` | Valid for the given month and year |
| `.month` | `1..12` | ISO / Python convention; not 0..11 |
| `.year` | full Gregorian year | `2024`, not `'24` or `124` |
| `.day_of_week` | `0..6` | `0=Monday`, `6=Sunday` (ISO 8601) |
